body_markdown:
Somewhere between Midland, Texas, and the Jornada del Muerto desert in New Mexico lies some of the emptiest sky in the United States. Four organisations now want to turn it into a racetrack for aircraft flying faster than sound.


On Wednesday 18 November 2026, Midland Development Corporation, Midland International Air & Space Port, the New Mexico Spaceport Authority, which runs Spaceport America, and the F-104 operator Starfighters Space signed a letter of intent to “jointly define, advocate for, and develop a dedicated high-speed flight test corridor” between the two spaceports. The announcement went out on Business Wire at 9:00 a.m. Eastern time.
